GitHub #517's design (mitcad#2140; opened with --open, never committed; tools/cli/y-tube-crotch-reported-test.cmake): Sweep1 (F3) sweeps Sketch2's circle of diameter 20 along Sketch1's line of 25 and a tangent quarter arc of radius 30; Mirror1 (F4) mirrors it about the YZ plane and joins it, a Y tube. Fillet1 (F5) rounds the crotch, a crease that fades to tangency where the arms leave the trunk, with d5 = 6 by one of its two edges and the tangent chain.

The Shell of the reporter's screenshot: the three ends open, 2 mm inside, Sharp, Tangent Chain on. Before, it failed with 'the geometry kernel's offset raised an error' at every radius (port patch 2140).
The rounding the reporter needs, 50 mm (before, it built up to 6 mm only: 'the geometry kernel's walk between the two faces fails'), and the Shell after it.
